title: Shibbydex (v2.5) News: Announcements (Version 2.5)
description: It's time for the latest Shibbydex announcements. Yay — I hope you're as excited as I am for everything that's coming. So just get comfy, and listen to me ramble about some upcoming future plans, my brand new partnerships, and get the low down on exciting haptic developments changing how you enjoy my files forever. Oh, and if you make it to the end, as a reward, there's also a festive competition I'm running that's open for everyone to enter. Happy Holidays! Partnership I have officially partnered up with The Handy team! We’ve had official meetings and everything, I felt very professional. I am going to be their flagship audio performer featured on their Handyverse App. Whilst other manufacturers are great for offering a wide range of vibration devices, The Handy is simply hands down the best stroker product out there, and it’s not even close. For launch, I’ve prepared twenty supported files already; free for everyone to enjoy as usual. There are also ongoing plans in the background to create some brand new audios in collaboration with The Handy Team, to specifically be used with the device too. And we’re going to be adding support soon for their vibrator — The Oh! — which is ideal for women or those who want a pure hitachi-style device. So watch this space!! Coming Soon . . . Speaking of my own upcoming plans. I want you all to know that more is on the horizon. With the new haptics implementation we are now at a position to branch out to another fun product that I have been wanting to add for a long time now: Electro Stimulation. Until now E-Stim devices have not really lent themselves to interactive support. But with the Coyote that has all now changed. It is affordable, supports both audio and bluetooth, and lets you choose from a range of attachments depending on what sort of stimulation you’d like to experience. Haptics Creation Competition COMPETITION ENTRY IS NOW CLOSED To celebrate, you're all encouraged to take part in the upcoming Haptics Creation Competition. Pick any audio of mine and create a haptic pattern for it! Submissions should be sent to [email protected] with the exact title: “Haptics Competition Submission”. Please include the following in your email: ( nb. Including the below details to the "Meta" data of the haptic file will also be appreciated. This is easily done from within the HapticEditor App ).The haptic file as an attachment.A Shibbydex link to the original audio file you created it for.What the intended toy is.The name by which you wish to be publicly credited by; or state that you wish to remain anonymous. Any further information or an explanation of what you’ve created. The event will run from today, until the end of January in 2025, in order to give you all plenty of time to learn what you’re doing before you submit your entries to me. Note that the Haptics Creation Competition will close at Midnight (EST) on January 31st; after which no further entries will be accepted. The submissions will be judged by myself and the current haptics creation team, but I can (and probably will) reserve the right to overrule them when it comes to awarding winners. There are also a few caveats...Rules First is: You can’t submit a pattern for an audio that already has haptic support added for that device on the Shibbydex. You can still submit a pattern for a file with pre-existing haptics, so long as it is for an entirely different style of device. Secondly: You agree that by entering into the Haptic Competition and submitting a haptic file and scripted pattern, you have given me permission for it to be released on the Shibbydex, even if you are not selected as one of the winners. Thirdly: You can submit as many files as you like, so go wild! Prizes You can’t run a competition without prizes now can you! We have plenty of products to be won. The prizes for this event have been kindly supplied by both The Handy Team and Lovense. If you win, you can select whichever product you’d like from the ones on offer and it’ll be shipped directly to you right away (assuming it hasn’t been picked already and one is still available). The gifts to be won are as follows: Handy (x3 available) Oh! (x5 available) Any Lovense product (x6 available) (-fine print: excluding "The Fucking Machine")The Haptic GuideWith the video class and tutorial in "The Haptic Guide" it should be super easy to learn the basics of creating haptic vibration scripts — trust me.
author: Mistress Shibby
